caption: The drawing displays a symmetrical composition with a central motif. At the top, there is a stylized cross outlined in a reddish-brown color with a beige fill and blue accent lines, and yellow shapes resembling rays emerging from behind it. Directly beneath the cross, there is a four-petaled floral or abstract design, each petal outlined in blue and reddish-brown with dotted patterns inside over a beige fill, and a circular center highlighted with blue and yellow rings. Flanking both sides of this central portion are two stylized wing-like shapes, colored beige with dark red tips. Below these elements is a large, detailed circular shape featuring a mandala-like design composed of geometric patterns and repeating motifs in beige, blue, and reddish-brown. The background is a light parchment-like texture with slightly darker edges.
title: Santa Barbara Mission Doorway Design from the portfolio "Decorative Art of Spanish California"
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
